fact: EUMETSAT says its SEWA project will sustain and upgrade the Regional ATOVS Retransmission Services network by modernising ground stations in Gabon, Kenya, Niger and South Africa for polar-orbiting satellite data.

The Kenya Meteorological Department says the African Union Commission, under ClimSA, installed and upgraded PUMA 2025 and ClimSA stations at KMD in August 2024, able to capture Meteosat Third Generation data.
EUMETSAT installed the first PUMA-2025 receiving station for Meteosat Third Generation data in Nairobi, Kenya, under the 2022 African Union-EUMETSAT agreement.
